headline: Insurance Industry Still Reluctant to Invest in Stocks, OJK Reveals the Reasons
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) reported insurance industry investments in equities of Rp111.71 trillion. It urged insurers to manage their portfolios more optimally.
why: Insurers are large institutional investors, and their allocation to equities affects domestic stock market demand and capital flows.
original_headline: Industri Asuransi Masih Enggan Investasi Saham, OJK Ungkap Penyebabnya
